Class AdvancementsItemGroup

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.char321.sfadvancements.core.AdvancementsItemGroup

  • public final class AdvancementsItemGroup
extends java.lang.Object
    Registers the advancement screen as a guide widget button rather than a custom guide layout. Addon custom guide screens are deprecated in this fork - addons contribute categories and items, and a GuideWidget for genuinely functional screens like the advancement tree.
